title: Before I retire, I want to share my methods with everyone, hoping they prove useful to you.
author: Ok-Basil2753
selftext:
My goal is to achieve a profit of 2 million by the end of this year and then take my family on a trip. Until I reach this goal, I will share my experiences here in the hope of helping others.

I will explain my methods following the sequence shown in the image:

Figure 3: When the price stabilizes above the 50 day and 200 day moving averages and forms a "Golden Cross," it indicates a healthy upward trend. Holding positions during this phase increases the probability of success.

Figure 4: Consider entering a trade only when the price pulls back near a key moving average (such as the 50 day MA). If the pullback is accompanied by shrinking volume followed by a rebound, it signals that market capital remains active, marking a low risk entry point.

Figure 5: After a period of consolidation at high levels, a breakout on high volume often signals that the trend is about to accelerate. At this point, following the trend is preferable to blindly chasing gains out of panic.

Figure 6: We employ a phased strategy, allocating capital in a 30% 30% 40% split. We first test the market to confirm the trend and then gradually increase our position, thereby maximizing potential returns while controlling risk.

Figure 7: Profits come from holding positions; as long as the price does not drop below key moving averages or structural lows, we continue to hold. If it does break below, we set a stop loss of 5% 8% to avoid significant drawdowns.

I run a stock discussion group where I share daily market insights for free, covering stock selection logic, risk warnings, trading opportunities, and entry points. I share my strategies and experiences at no cost to help those eager to learn, seeking inspiration, or interested in different perspectives on achieving financial freedom. If you are also pursuing financial freedom, feel free to contact me or share your thoughts; I enjoy exchanging ideas and growing together with others. Please note that this post does not constitute investment advice; I read and reply to every private message. I am also keen to learn how others handle trading and risk management.

I wish everyone steady progress and success in the market. In short: profits come from repeating the right trading process, not from chasing the "perfect" trade. May love be with everyone, and I wish good luck to all those still navigating the market.
